text: Centre foreground: a white plastic holder resting at an angle on a grey aluminium extrusion rail, carrying a rectangular plate with a grid of square wells (roughly four rows of three) holding pale blue-green liquid; the wells are uncapped and open. Attached to the plate's right end is a clear plate bearing a black-and-white square fiducial marker printed with "620". Behind it lies a dark gasket-like frame and a round white cap or disc on the bench. Lower left: a white circular platform with a ring groove, plus two metal dowel pins. Upper right: a white robot arm joint with black cabling; white posts and a black block at upper left. Background: white bench surfaces.
